changes.note: The fact stores the report's 180,000 lines/s figure on the research shelf with its limits: plain TCP, lines of 200 bytes or less, disk buffer off, TLS not measured, and TLS planned for Q4.

grade.answer_reason: It says no TLS run was made and that the 200-byte lines don't match the agents' 900-byte lines at 50,000 lines/s, notes the 180,000 lines/s at 85% CPU on one vCPU, and recommends an own TLS test or the Q4 report; its 15-20% TLS figure is a clearly marked 'if', not a claim.
